summary: Verified security fixes SEC-001 (removed /api/status routes) and SEC-002 (no allow-credentials) via pytest, plus frontend smoke on Alok Kumawat portfolio. 4/4 backend tests pass; frontend loads, navbar->projects works, contact form shows expected EmailJS fallback, no horizontal overflow at 1440/390, no JS page errors (only 2 unrelated 404s for missing static assets like favicon).
action_items: Optional: silence the two 404 console errors on load (likely favicon/robots or a missing image). Not security-critical but polish.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still imports motor and opens an AsyncIOMotorClient although no endpoint uses the DB anymore. Since the app is now a pure health stub, consider dropping motor/pymongo and the MONGO_URL/DB_NAME requirement, or wrapping it in try/except to avoid startup failure if Mongo is unreachable.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' when unset; since allow_credentials=False that is acceptable, but consider pinning to the production origin(s) explicitly for defense-in-depth.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (4 tests: health + POST/GET /api/status both 404 + no allow-credentials header). Run via pytest with junitxml. Frontend hero requires ~5s wait for intro loader; use data-testid=hero-heading, nav-projects-button, contact-name-input/contact-email-input/contact-message-input/contact-submit-button, contact-form-status. Contact fallback text is the expected 'Add EmailJS keys in frontend/.env to activate this form.'
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - fixes verified. Ingress adds its own permissive CORS headers (access-control-allow-origin:* and full method list) at edge, but critically the origin server no longer emits access-control-allow-credentials:true, so credentialed cross-origin reads are blocked by the browser as required.
